sentence: This project builds a robotic system that uses large language models to repair aged electric vehicle batteries.
This project studies how tiny cracks start and grow inside metals that are used again and again.
This project tests how ion beam irradiation of high-temperature superconductors changes the largest current they can carry.
This project builds a web map and tools that show where wetlands are now and were in the past.
This project builds teams of robots that cut and catch the lower branches of trees to reduce fuel for forest fires.
This project builds a virtual reality system to help parents who lost a child to cancer feel connected and find meaning in grief.
This project builds ways to defend learning systems made of many cooperating agents against attacks by malicious agents.
This project coordinates research teams that study why people move or stay in a time of global change.
This project builds drone simulations with robotics and artificial intelligence that teach high school physics and Python programming.
This project makes magnetic films with changing chemical makeup to switch magnetic memory with less wasted energy.
This project studies how people learn to control a robotic arm from finger motions and how the robot's controls should be set up.
This project builds a theory of how hard it is to work out properties of quantum states with a computer.
This project builds electronic devices that copy how the cerebellum sends signals, in order to detect anomalies quickly.
This project sets up an electron microscope to study the tiny structure of materials such as alloy nanoparticles and battery cathodes.
This project extends a software tool that differentiates scientific code so that it can be used in optimization.
This project adds hands-on hardware and software training to a computer forensics course and tests how well it works.
This project builds maize lines and virus-based tools that deliver guide RNAs so that genes can be edited in maize plants.
